summary: Zero-K is an open-source real-time strategy game built on the Spring RTS engine. It offers competitive matches centred around physics-based mechanics, terrain manipulation, and a diverse unit roster.
goodFor: Self-hosters and communities looking to run an open-source, competitive RTS title with custom physics and terrain manipulation features.
watchOut: The project lacks tagged releases, which can complicate release management, and relies on an niche game engine that may present a steep operational learning curve.
deployNotes: Hosting typically requires setting up the Spring engine environment and ensuring adequate persistent storage for game assets and server logs.
